name: PT Habco Trans Maritima Tbk
summary: PT Habco Trans Maritima Tbk is an Indonesian company primarily involved in the ownership and operation of vessels designed for bulk cargo. The firm offers a comprehensive range of maritime services, including barging, transshipment, and dedicated bulk carrier operations. Its shipping activities cover a diverse array of goods, such as dangerous items, hazardous and toxic waste, various petroleum products (like fuel oil, processed derivatives, LPG, LNG, and CNG), and fish. Furthermore, the company provides marine transportation rental services and operates these assets. Founded in 2019 and based in Pekanbaru, Indonesia, the company currently manages a fleet of three bulk carriers. PT Habco Trans Maritima Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Habco Primatama.
